design_philosophy: Friendly, optimistic, and structured. Uses pastel backgrounds with hard black borders and offset shadows to make the dashboard engaging for students while keeping it highly functional for admins.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. p-6 to p-8 inside cards. Gap-6 between grid items.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 border-r-2 border-black bg-amber-50/50 p-6 flex flex-col gap-4

cards.base: bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-xl p-6 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-transform

buttons.primary: bg-sky-400 text-black border-2 border-black rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-bold shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] active:translate-y-1 active:translate-x-1 active:shadow-none transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-amber-300 text-black border-2 border-black rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-bold shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] active:translate-y-1 active:translate-x-1 active:shadow-none transition-all

badges.admin: bg-red-300 text-black border-2 border-black rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide
badges.student: bg-sky-300 text-black border-2 border-black rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide

inputs.base: w-full bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-lg px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-sky-200 transition-all text-black placeholder:text-neutral-400

file_upload.base: w-full border-2 border-dashed border-black rounded-xl bg-sky-50 p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer hover:bg-sky-100 transition-colors

animations.hover: Quick structural transitions (0.15s ease-out) for offset shadows and transforms.
animations.list_stagger: Framer motion staggered entrance for task lists (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).

images.description: Colorful school supplies including notebook, pencil case, and tablet on a desk. Used for the split-screen login page.

icons.style: Bold, 24px, 2px stroke width to match the neo-brutalist aesthetic.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Extremely high contrast due to black borders and text on pastel backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='task-card-1').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the main structural layouts (sidebar, grid) to easily implement the hard offset shadows and borders.

For complex interactives (Dropdowns, Dialogs for creating tasks, DatePicker for deadlines), use Shadcn UI but aggressively override the default styling to match the Neo-brutalist (border-2 border-black, sharp shadows) theme.
Implement a clear visual toggle or indication for Admin vs Aluno views.
Ensure all text is in Portuguese (PT-BR) as requested.
For file uploads, use an aesthetically pleasing dashed dropzone.
Maintain the layout density: 'Control Room' for admins (data heavy, lists of students and tasks) and 'Bento' grid for students (engaging task cards).
